svg.text: Figure 3 · What perception can get wrong, and what is planned
The perception insufficiencies of WP-C-06 with their triggering conditions, the hazards they lead to, the planned modifications and the AI requirements written against them.
Lane/path estimate wrong or unstable when markings are faded, missing, doubled (old and …
Degraded perception in poor visibility (rain, fog, spray), low sun, oncoming glare, low light …
Out-of-distribution input (unusual road layouts, construction, speeds above training data) …
Lead detection misses stationary vehicles not seen moving and objects other than vehicles …
e2e acceleration misinterprets traffic lights/signs: false stops and missed stops
Radar false targets from overhead structures, metal plates, toll booths; misassociation of a …
Lead kept or dropped wrongly when the model is uncertain (lead kept "when uncertain" …
Calibration drift after mount disturbance; wrong pose in banked or crowned roads …
Reduced detection with sunglasses, low light, glare, face partly out of view, obstructions …
Temporal effects: model lag or frame drops degrade the plan; recurrent state reset after …
Each row is parsed from the work products: WP-C-06 §3 (Type P) and §5, WP-C-05 §6, and the Parent column of WP-C-11 §6.
